verification_method: Every listed URL was checked with a plain request: no cookies, no referer, browser user agent only. hotlink_ok is true only for a 2xx status with an image/* content type. Where a HEAD response was unusable (Squarespace CDN reports Content-Length 1), a 2048-byte range GET was used instead. Nothing that failed was listed as usable.
